items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if the cohomology theory over the larger field satisfies axioms (A1) to (A9), then so does the theory over the smaller field, given compatible data and compatible Chern class diagrams (statement lines 5444-5474). The proof (proof lines 5475-5616) transfers the axioms one by one, using linear algebra principles for the formal axioms, a Chern character and splitting principle argument for the compatibility of the cycle class map, and the Kunneth decomposition of the diagonal for the two remaining axioms. H3: a long axiom by axiom verification with several independent arguments, written out in full.
